nodes.label: ollama-rs Integration Plan
nodes.rationale: Adds a native Ollama provider additively — Ollama stays usable via the OpenAI-compatible shim — under non-negotiable compatibility constraints: Provider trait unchanged, factory default resolution unchanged, all new fields Option<T> defaulting to None so other providers see zero behavior change.

nodes.label: ollama-rs Crate
nodes.rationale: Built on reqwest 0.12, incompatible with the crate's reqwest 0.11 ProviderError::HttpError — network errors therefore map to ApiError{status:0} and are never retried by retry_with_backoff.

nodes.label: OllamaProvider (Native)
nodes.rationale: The native /api/chat API unlocks what the OpenAI-compat shim never returns: model management (list/pull/show/delete), pull progress, keep_alive, num_ctx, embeddings, typed multimodal input, and native performance metrics (total/load/prompt_eval/eval durations).

nodes.label: PerfMetrics
nodes.rationale: All fields are Option<T> defaulting to None so providers that don't expose runtime metrics (Anthropic, OpenAI, Qwen, Azure) have zero behavior or display change; stored as JSON in a nullable DB column since the metrics are informative, not analytical; tokens/sec derived as eval_count / eval_duration.

nodes.label: Model Download Dialog (Ctrl+D)
nodes.rationale: Ollama exposes no online catalog-search API, so the dialog is repo:tag name entry assisted by installed models plus a hard-coded curated list (CURATED_MODELS), not hub search; cancellation via JoinHandle::abort() on the pull task (no CancellationToken needed); one active pull at a time.

nodes.label: Ollama Embeddings Capability
nodes.rationale: Exposed only as a raw capability (generate_embeddings + crustly ollama embed) because Crustly has no RAG/retrieval layer to attach it to — verified that no embedding reference existed in the code before this phase.
